complete_run.note: The fixture's head run, 2026-01-09 16:00 through 21:45 UTC, is bar-complete: 346 consecutive minute bars folding to 69 full five-minute buckets plus the one-bar 21:45 stub. Past 21:45 the fixture is a torn after-hours tape, so the oracle folds the head run, not the file.
complete_run.hole_note: Folding the whole file yields exactly one five-minute gap, at the bucket above; the shipped five-minute fixture is missing the same bucket, so two independent grids agree the hole is genuine and the fold reproduces it instead of hiding it.
complete_run.tail_note: The file holds 436 bars: the 346-bar head run plus a 90-bar torn tail. The total is frozen so the head-run slice cannot shift silently under a fixture edit.

agreement.reason: Only the 23 fifteen-minute buckets fully covered by minute bars (2026-01-09 16:00 through 21:30) are comparable: the minute fixture starts a day later than the fifteen-minute fixture and its tail past 21:45 is torn. All 23 agree exactly, prices and volume.
